page_title: HyprMac: keyboard-driven tiling window manager for macOS

sources.entry: HyprMac - Keyboard-driven tiling window manager inspired by Hyprland, with automatic dwindle layout and ten workspaces. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/zacharytgray/HyprMac) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.name: HyprMac
summary.one_liner: HyprMac is a free, open-source, keyboard-driven tiling window manager for macOS, inspired by Hyprland, that arranges windows in a dwindle (BSP) layout.
use_cases: Tile windows automatically on a Mac without using the mouse
Switch between ten workspaces from the keyboard
Move and resize windows with keyboard chords
Save and restore window layouts for a set of displays
Pin apps to specific workspaces or the scratchpad
Script window management with hyprmac:// links from Raycast or BetterTouchTool
summary.what_it_does: HyprMac automatically tiles windows in a dwindle (BSP) layout as they are opened. Users move focus, swap, and resize windows, and switch between ten workspaces using keyboard bindings. Gaps are configurable, and a floating scratchpad is available with one key. Bindings are editable in Settings → Keys with a key recorder, and the Hypr modifier key can be chosen from 14 options (Caps Lock by default). It also supports saved layouts per display setup, per-workspace home monitors, app pinning, and overview of workspaces, and it exposes bindings to scripts and hyprmac:// links.
notable: Dwindle (BSP) automatic tiling inspired by Hyprland
Editable keybinds with key recorder and 14 Hypr key choices
Saved layouts restored when the same displays are reconnected
Installable via Homebrew cask; signed, notarized universal app that self-updates via Sparkle
caveats: Requires macOS 13 or later and System Integrity Protection (SIP) must stay on
Caps Lock as the Hypr key needs a System Settings Modifier Keys setting that is per keyboard
Page describes the project as in active development
